fields.title: Sum Array
fields.description:
Read N, then N lines. Print sum of list.

<!-- AI_CONTEXT: Providing hints for python learners. -->
fields.reference_solution:
n = int(input())
s = 0
for _ in range(n): s += int(input())
print(s)
